name: Tradepak Inc
old_description: At Tradepak Inc., we offer cutting-edge flexible packaging solutions for the food industry. We emphasize quality, efficiency, and sustainability.
about:
Tradepak Inc. was founded in 2003 in Miami, Florida, and operates a production plant in South Florida. The company describes itself as a North American flexible packaging manufacturer with permanent commercial representation in the Caribbean and Central America.

The company manufactures a range of flexible packaging products for the food industry, including vacuum pouches, shrink bags, stand-up bags, polyethylene, polypropylene, and polyester films, monolayer and multilayer films, rollstock films, and technical laminates. Its in-house processes cover 8-color flexographic printing, precision slitting, lamination, laser perforation and scoring, and packaging consulting. All conversion takes place in its Miami facility under FDA standards.

Tradepak serves multiple segments of the food industry—poultry, beef, seafood, produce, pet food, frozen food, cereals and bakery, and dairy—supplying both large corporations and small businesses. A testimonial also references a project for an apparel brand, indicating occasional work outside food packaging.

The company highlights its strategic location minutes from Miami International Airport for rapid distribution across the Americas, a bilingual sales team, SQF certification from NSF, and a sustainability focus that includes eco-friendly practices. It also emphasizes over 20 years of experience and consulting expertise spanning 30 years of market knowledge.
